headline.en: Carry local agent state between workspaces
headline.zh: 把本地 Agent 状态迁移到新目录

sub.en: CarryState packs Claude Code session files, Markdown memories and MCP configuration into a .csb bundle, verifies its checksums, and writes a Codex-oriented directory layout.
sub.zh: CarryState 将 Claude Code 会话文件、Markdown 记忆和 MCP 配置打包为 .csb 文件，校验内容后写入面向 Codex 的目录布局。

body.en: Move .csb files through an internal file share or removable media.
body.zh: 可通过内部文件共享或移动介质传递 .csb 文件。

body.en: Unpack recomputes checksums and refuses a mismatching bundle.
body.zh: 解包时重新计算校验值，拒绝内容不匹配的包。

body.en: The exporter stores raw JSONL and the importer writes that content back.
body.zh: 导出器保存原始 JSONL，导入器写回对应内容。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: The example creates synthetic source files in a temporary directory and runs the actual pack, verify and unpack commands. It never reads your ~/.claude or writes your ~/.codex.
note.zh: 示例在临时目录创建合成输入，调用实际的 pack、verify 和 unpack 命令。不会读取个人 ~/.claude 或写入 ~/.codex。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/carrystate.git
cd carrystate
go build -o bin/carrystate ./cmd/carrystate

limitations.en: Checksum agreement establishes bundle consistency, not signer identity, runtime compatibility or behavior equivalence.
limitations.zh: 校验值一致仅证明包内容一致，不能证明签名身份、运行时兼容性或行为等价。

limitations.en: The Codex layout is an adapter convention. This demo does not launch Codex or verify that a current Codex release resumes the imported session.
limitations.zh: Codex 布局是适配器约定。本示例没有启动 Codex，也没有验证当前 Codex 版本能恢复导入会话。

limitations.en: Reverse migration and semantic memory reconciliation are not implemented.
limitations.zh: 反向迁移和记忆语义协调尚未实现。

body.en: Moving a local agent setup involves several kinds of files with different locations and formats. A bundle keeps the transcript, instructions and tool configuration together, with an inspectable manifest and a check before unpacking.
body.zh: 迁移本地 Agent 环境需要处理分散在不同位置、格式不同的文件。统一的包把会话文本、指令和工具配置放在一起，并提供可查看的清单和解包前校验。

body.en: The Claude Code adapter reads projects/<project>/*.jsonl, global and discoverable project CLAUDE.md files, and MCP server entries. The bundle module addresses entries by SHA-256 and computes a Merkle root. The Codex adapter writes sessions, merges Markdown with provenance headers and serializes mcp.json.
body.zh: Claude Code 适配器读取 projects/<project>/*.jsonl、全局及可定位的项目 CLAUDE.md 和 MCP 条目。bundle 模块以 SHA-256 标识条目并计算 Merkle 根。Codex 适配器写出会话、为合并的 Markdown 添加来源注释，并生成 mcp.json。

title.en: Export, verify, then write a target layout
title.zh: 导出、校验、写入目标目录

body.en: The Claude Code adapter reads projects/<project>/*.jsonl, global and discoverable project CLAUDE.md files, and MCP server entries. The bundle module addresses entries by SHA-256 and computes a Merkle root. The Codex adapter writes sessions, merges Markdown with provenance headers and serializes mcp.json.
body.zh: Claude Code 适配器读取 projects/<project>/*.jsonl、全局及可定位的项目 CLAUDE.md 和 MCP 条目。bundle 模块以 SHA-256 标识条目并计算 Merkle 根。Codex 适配器写出会话、为合并的 Markdown 添加来源注释，并生成 mcp.json。

alt.en: Export, verify, then write a target layout
alt.zh: 导出、校验、写入目标目录

body.en: CarryState handles file packaging and deterministic translation. The destination runtime owns whether it recognizes and resumes those files. The supported direction is Claude Code export → Codex-oriented import; the reverse methods return unsupported-direction errors.
body.zh: CarryState 负责文件打包和确定性转换；目标运行时负责识别和恢复这些文件。当前方向是 Claude Code 导出到面向 Codex 的布局，反向接口会返回不支持的方向错误。

body.en: All paths are explicit CLI arguments. The Claude Code project-directory decoding is best effort because hyphens can be ambiguous. Global Markdown is concatenated with source comments; MCP configuration is serialized as mcp.json. Bundles may contain sensitive session content and MCP environment values, so choose their destination as carefully as the original state files.
body.zh: 路径均通过 CLI 参数指定。Claude Code 项目目录中的连字符可能产生歧义，因此路径还原是尽力处理。全局 Markdown 通过来源注释拼接；MCP 配置序列化为 mcp.json。包可能包含敏感会话和 MCP 环境变量，应按原始状态文件的要求选择存放位置。

body.en: Replace ./source-state with a source directory you intend to export. Use --project to restrict one encoded project subdirectory, or --mcp-config to select an explicit MCP JSON file. Import into a new directory first: the importer writes target files and is not a conflict-aware merge tool. See SPEC.md and examples/happy-path.md for the file contract.
body.zh: 将 ./source-state 替换为准备导出的目录。--project 可限定一个编码后的项目子目录，--mcp-config 可指定 MCP JSON 文件。先导入新目录：导入器会写入目标文件，并不提供冲突感知合并。文件约定见 SPEC.md 和 examples/happy-path.md。

details.code:
./bin/carrystate pack --harness claudecode --state-dir ./source-state --out project.csb
./bin/carrystate verify --bundle project.csb
./bin/carrystate unpack --harness codex --in project.csb --state-dir ./imported-state --dry-run
./bin/carrystate unpack --harness codex --in project.csb --state-dir ./imported-state
